text:
Zoe Kim: Hey team — SlatePay sent renewal INV-SP-0426 but AP flagged the invoice: it lists 5k included API calls/month which is way lower than our telemetry. Can someone confirm what plan they think we're on?

Marcus Bell: Upload the pdf? I can cross-check with our ingestion logs.

Zoe Kim: PDF here: https://files.redwood/procurement/slatepay_renewal_apr.pdf — summary: Pro plan $36k/yr (5 seats + 5k calls/mo), onboarding $3k, overage $0.015/call.

Marcus Bell: That's clearly wrong. Our last quarter calls: Feb 2026 1.1M, Mar 2026 950k, Apr 2026 1.05M. We're heavy API, never had a 5k/mo cap.

Elena (SlatePay Sales): Hi Zoe, thanks for the ping. Sorry about the template mix-up — system defaulted to "Pro". We usually offer committed consumption for API-first customers. I can offer two options: (A) 3M calls/yr at $0.007/call + seats $4k = $25k/yr, onboarding waived for pilot; (B) 12M calls/yr at $0.0045/call + seats $10k = $64k/yr, onboarding waived. Both include monthly invoices showing math and a 30-day pilot term.

Zoe Kim: Option A is low on volume; option B seems more aligned with our run rate (3.1M qtrly ~12M/yr). Elena, can you lock price for 12 months and give us an overage cap in dollars?

Rajesh Gupta: Procurement & Finance checklist: 1) Need written committed unit price and term (12 months), 2) Monthly maximum overage cap in USD (preferably $5k/mo), 3) Pilot termination rights (60 days), 4) Net30 payment, 5) DPA + SOC2 + data deletion clause, 6) Invoice template that shows committed math for AP. Also route to FinanceOps if >$25k/yr.

Elena (SlatePay Sales): We can lock the $0.0045/call for 12 months if signed by EOM. Overage after commit at $0.006/call but we can cap overage to $5k/mo for the first 6 months. I'll add a clause for 60-day pilot termination and include the DPA/SOC2.

Marcus Bell: Please get the overage cap as an absolute dollar amount in the SOW, not just "first 6 months" language. For budgeting it's important to have it explicit for the 12-month term or at least a guaranteed first-year cap.

Zoe Kim: Also ask Legal about indemnity and export controls — SlatePay processes PII in some flows so DPA needs to be explicit about subprocessors.

Elena (SlatePay Sales): Understood. I'll push for a first-year overage cap of $60k (which is $5k/mo) in the contract and will attach our DPA and SOC2 report. I'll post a redline within the hour.

BillingBot: Reminder: Any vendor commit > $50k/yr requires VP Finance approval per policy: https://intra.redwood/finance/vendor-commits.

Rajesh Gupta: Noted. If option B nets ~ $74k/yr (calls + seats) we'll need VP sign-off. Can you also provide a usage CSV snippet for the vendor? Marcus, can you paste recent numbers?

Marcus Bell: Pasting usage snapshot to include in email to vendor:
```
month,api_calls
2026-02,1100000
2026-03,950000
2026-04,1050000
```

Marcus Bell: Draft subject: "SlatePay renewal - request for committed consumption pricing & first-year overage cap". I'll draft the counter email and post it here for review.

Zoe Kim: Please include a request to update the current invoice to "pro forma - pending commit" so AP doesn't process the wrong charge. We need the corrected invoice before we route to PO.

Elena (SlatePay Sales): Will update the invoice to "Pending - committed consumption" and upload corrected PDF. Posting redline now: https://docs.redwood/contracts/slatepay-counter-0426.md.

Rajesh Gupta: Once redline is in Legal/Procurement I'll route to VP Finance for approval (assuming option B). Thumbs-up here when draft email is ready.

Zoe Kim: Reviewing the draft now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
